pid.description: Optional pid filter. When set, only this pid's windows are returned.

name: list_windows
description: Discover live windows without activating them.

include_screenshot.description: Default true — returns a grounding screenshot alongside the tree. Set false to skip the grab and return tree only (the cheap path for re-indexing before an element ax action).

max_depth.description: Cap on the UIA-tree walk depth. Nodes whose rendered indent would exceed this are omitted. Omit for the default (25). Lower for deep menu / Electron trees.

max_elements.description: Cap on the total number of UIA nodes walked. Truncates depth-first; markdown and structured elements truncate together. Omit for the default (5 000). Lower for Electron / large web apps that produce 10k+ element trees.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring. Projects both tree_markdown and structured elements to matches plus ancestors while preserving original indices. Compare total_element_count with returned_element_count.

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Must belong to `pid`. Enumerate via `list_windows` or read from `launch_app`'s `windows` array.

name: get_window_state
description: Inspect an exact window; use bounded depth/elements and request screenshots only when needed.

element_index.description: Element index from get_window_state. Requires the matching `snapshot_id` alongside it. Prefer `element_token`, which carries both values.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. If element_index, snapshot_id, or window_id are also supplied they must agree. Returns an explicit stale error once a newer snapshot supersedes it.

pid.description: Target process ID for window scope. Omit with scope=desktop for screen-absolute coordinates from get_desktop_state.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot handle from get_window_state. Required when targeting by element_index; stale snapshots fail closed.

window_id.description: HWND for the window whose get_window_state produced the element_index. Required when element_index is used. Optional when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

x.description: X in window-local screenshot pixels — same space as the PNG get_window_state returns. Must be provided together with y.

y.description: Y in window-local screenshot pixels. Must be provided together with x.

name: click
description: Background click on the exact window. Ground in a fresh snapshot; verify the actual effect afterward.

name: right_click
description: Background right click on the exact window. Ground in a fresh snapshot; verify the actual effect afterward.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of drag path. Default: 500.

from_x.description: Drag-start X in window-local screenshot pixels.

from_y.description: Drag-start Y in window-local screenshot pixels.

to_x.description: Drag-end X in window-local screenshot pixels.

to_y.description: Drag-end Y in window-local screenshot pixels.

window_id.description: Target window handle (HWND). Optional — driver picks frontmost window of pid when omitted.

name: drag
description: Background drag on the exact window. Ground in a fresh snapshot; verify the actual effect afterward.

element_index.description: Element index from the last get_window_state for the same (pid, window_id). When supplied, type_text writes through UIA ValuePattern and reads that exact element back by handle. The shared ActionResult is confirmed only when the complete expected value is synchronously visible. If SetValue succeeds but read-back is stale or unavailable, the result is unverifiable with no escalation; take a fresh snapshot before retrying because deferred providers may publish only after this call returns. Requires window_id.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. If element_index, snapshot_id, or window_id are also supplied they must agree. Returns an explicit stale error once a newer snapshot supersedes it.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot handle from get_window_state. Required when targeting by element_index; stale snapshots fail closed.

text.description: Text to insert at the focused element's cursor.

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Required when element_index is used. Optional when element_token is supplied (the token carries it).

x.description: Window-local screenshot-pixel X of the field to type into — the element px action form. Pass x,y (no element_index) and the tool pixel-clicks there to establish real renderer focus, then types. Use for Chromium/Electron inputs the UIA/WM_CHAR path can't reach. Read straight off the get_window_state PNG, same convention as click.

y.description: Window-local screenshot-pixel Y of the field (see x).

name: type_text
description: Background type text on the exact window. Ground in a fresh snapshot; verify the actual effect afterward.

element_index.description: Optional element_index from the last get_window_state; focuses that UIA element before the key is delivered.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. If element_index, snapshot_id, or window_id are also supplied they must agree. Returns an explicit stale error once a newer snapshot supersedes it.

key.description: Key name (return, tab, escape, up, down, left, right, space, delete, home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12, letter, digit).

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot handle from get_window_state. Required when targeting by element_index; stale snapshots fail closed.

window_id.description: HWND for the target window. Required when element_index is used; otherwise auto-resolves the pid's first visible window.

x.description: Window-local screenshot-pixel X — the element px action form: pixel-click there to focus, then send the key. Use when the key must go to a Chromium/Electron surface the UIA path can't focus. Pass with y, no element_index.

name: press_key
description: Background press key on the exact window. Ground in a fresh snapshot; verify the actual effect afterward.

element_index.description: Optional element_index. Accepted for parity; currently no-op on Windows.

element_token.description: Opaque per-snapshot element handle from `structuredContent.elements[].element_token`. If element_index, snapshot_id, or window_id are also supplied they must agree. Returns an explicit stale error once a newer snapshot supersedes it.

pid.description: Target process ID for window scope. Omit with scope=desktop for screen-absolute coordinates from get_desktop_state.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot handle from get_window_state. Required when targeting by element_index; stale snapshots fail closed.

window_id.description: HWND of the target window. Required when element_index is used; otherwise auto-resolves the pid's first visible window.

x.description: With pid/window_id: window-local screenshot X used to target a nested scroll surface in foreground mode. Without pid/window_id: screen-absolute X for desktop scope. Must be paired with y.

y.description: With pid/window_id: window-local screenshot Y used to target a nested scroll surface in foreground mode. Without pid/window_id: screen-absolute Y for desktop scope. Must be paired with x.

name: scroll
description: Background scroll on the exact window. Ground in a fresh snapshot; verify the actual effect afterward.
